slides.headline: 7 EXPENSIVE BUSINESS TASKS GPT-5 NOW DOES IN MINUTES, ONE FOUND $1,068 IN A FORGOTTEN SUBSCRIPTION

slides.body: Most people re-explain their business to GPT-5 from scratch every session. A café owner typed her tone in once, every email it writes now sounds exactly like her.

slides.body: He rehearsed the objections he feared most in GPT-5 Voice Mode at 11pm. When the real client pushed back on price, he had already handled that exact moment a dozen times.
